meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
to try hard, do one's best

examples.trans: Try to manage without our help.
I will try to come on time.

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

meanings.en: to try, to taste (food or drink)

examples.trans: Try the tea with bread rings.

meanings.note: 'брать' alone often means this, in talk about officials

examples.trans: We have to take all the money.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: the person who likes is in the dative: мне нравится = I like it

examples.trans: He talks for a long time.

to learn how to do something

examples.trans: But you studied together with him!
I'm sick of this communal flat.
